cases.name: Kathlyn Elizabeth “Katie” Poirier
cases.about: Katie hoped one day to become a corrections officer. Her Find-a-Grave said, "Katie was an honor roll student, band musician, and Key Club member at Barnum High School in Barnum Township, MN. In 1997, she was named first runner-up for the title of "Miss Barnum." She went on to attend Fond du Lac Community College. She was the fiancee of Mark Johnson. Among her many interests were water-skiing, fishing, the Green Bay Packers, "Days of Our Lives," and her beloved dogs Goldie and Riley. Katie had a mile-wide smile and simply loved life and everyone in it. She will forever be remembered, and she will always be a precious part of everyone who was fortunate enough to know her."
cases.narrative: He abducted her from the D. J.'s Expressway Conoco convenience store in Moose Lake, MN, where she worked as a night clerk. He took her to his property, strangled her to death and burned her body on his fire pit, where investigators discovered her bone fragments and a tooth.
